requires: Reasoning is on by default and comes back in message.reasoning; set include_reasoning: false to leave it out.
Remove reasoning_format: it isn't supported on this model, and it can't be combined with include_reasoning.

Raise max_completion_tokens if it was tuned for a non-reasoning model: the reasoning page says the 1024 default may be too low.
